ownership_notes: FightAttackState stays native owned memory; the port uses BorgState rather than defining a second state struct.
Race/kind FFI copies contain pointers; expose only owned scalar/flag metadata used by this policy. Pointer-presence friends checks become one owned boolean with identical meaning.
Race/blow names and z_info references are immutable loaded-table data valid for the process lifetime; they confer no engine-object token or mutable world access.
borg_inc_motion mutates caller-owned integer outputs: capture both outputs and replay them, not only its unit return.

Trip forecast takes &mut BorgState and may mutate owned trip memory. The shared town journey adapter is a recorded effect returning the needed i64 turns; attack still owns oil-reserve arithmetic/selection.
Five mutable public entries use typed transactions; readonly thrust and pure blow classification need scalar comparisons and matching internal entry markers.
Telemetry expansion must implement #339 with an explicit schema change and separate policy markers/actual dependency requests. Historical @1 data remains immutable.
All native BI reads map to existing named accessor fields; no dynamic trait-index argument occurs in this file. Mana simulation remains the sole audited BI write adapter.
